title: Transformers for Robotics
desc: Deep neural networks based on self-attention are revolutionizing robotics with their ability to perform "open world" reasoning across multiple modalities including text and images, and to generate multi-modal data ranging from text to actions.

title: Introduction to Robotics
desc: Creates an appreciation for the tight interplay between mechanism, sensor, and control in the design of intelligent systems — including formally describing the forward and inverse kinematics and dynamics of robotic systems, and programming perception, planning, and control.
